n1.speaker: narrator
n1.text: That evening Pell lays a sheet on your desk: the Tarrow original, black ink, uncreased. The Wardens, to their credit, have sent her back.

n2.speaker: npc_pell
n2.text: Linen. Accused, acquitted, wages withheld. That's what happened. What you stamped is what somebody needed to have happened.

n3.speaker: npc_pell
n3.text: The case is open again and the original is in it. Link the two and file your correction. I was never here.
